label.purpose: Uppercase table column headers. Authored 600/10px; renders bold 12px because the font shorthand is invalid.

shadows.name: launcher-float
shadows.purpose: Lifts the resting launcher pill off the host page.

shadows.name: panel-float
shadows.purpose: Lifts the open panel off the host page. Same value in dark mode, where it nearly vanishes.

components.name: Launcher
components.description: Dark capsule pinned bottom-right; opens the panel and counts active overrides.
components.css: .ds-launcher { background: #111827; color: #f3f4f6; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13.33px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); } .ds-launcher:hover { background: #1f2937; } .ds-launcher:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-launcher-badge { display: inline-block; background: #dc2626; color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 6px; margin-left: 6px; font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Header actions (Refresh, Reset all) and the empty-state Retry.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 13.33px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1f2937; border-color: #4b5563; color: #f3f4f6; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #374151; } }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirm action ('Clear') in the reset confirmation bar.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #dc2626; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 13.33px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #b91c1c; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dc2626; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Method Pills
components.description: Solid mono pills color-coded by HTTP method.
components.html: GET POST PUT DELETE HEAD
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; font: 600 10px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 3px; color: #fff; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-pill-get { background: #2563eb; } .ds-pill-post { background: #16a34a; } .ds-pill-put { background: #d97706; } .ds-pill-delete { background: #dc2626; } .ds-pill-other { background: #6b7280; }

components.name: Scenario Select
components.description: Native select picking a route's scenario; 'default' always first.
components.css: .ds-select { width: 180px; font: 12px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 1px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-select { background: #1f2937; border-color: #4b5563; color: #f3f4f6; } }

components.name: Route Table
components.description: Signature component: sticky uppercase header, method pill, mono URL, scenario select, active dot.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 440px; border-collapse: collapse; font: 12px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; color: #111827; background: #fff; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { text-align: left; padding: 6px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-table th { background: #f9fafb; color: #4b5563; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-tpill { display: inline-block; font: 600 10px/1 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 3px; color: #fff; } .ds-url { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; } .ds-tselect { width: 100%; font: inherit; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; } .ds-na { color: #9ca3af; font-style: italic; } .ds-active { width: 24px; text-align: center; } .ds-dot { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2563eb; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-table { background: #1f2937; color: #f3f4f6; } .ds-table th { background: #111827; color: #d1d5db; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { border-bottom-color: #374151; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: #374151; } .ds-tselect { background: #1f2937; border-color: #4b5563; color: #f3f4f6; } }

components.name: Confirm Bar
components.description: Inline strip asking to clear all scenario selections.
components.html: Clear all scenario selections?
components.css: .ds-confirm { width: 440px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #fef2f2; border-bottom: 1px solid #fecaca; color: #7f1d1d; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 12px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-confirm span { flex: 1; } .ds-confirm-yes { background: #dc2626; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-confirm-no { background: #fff; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-confirm { background: #7f1d1d; border-bottom-color: #991b1b; color: #fee2e2; } .ds-confirm-no { background: #1f2937; border-color: #4b5563; color: #f3f4f6; } }

narrative.overview:
The only designed surface is the dev-tools overlay: a dark pill launcher pinned bottom-right, and a 440px side panel holding one dense table of routes. It borrows the look of a generic browser-devtools utility, built from the stock Tailwind gray, blue, green, amber and red values, hand-typed into a CSS string. The panel is utilitarian and compact (12px text, 6px row padding), and it has no brand expression beyond the lowercase wordmark "apitemkin" on the launcher and the "apitemkin · scenarios" header. The README's Potemkin wit appears nowhere in the UI.

It lives inside a closed shadow root in someone else's app, so every value is self-contained: no custom properties, no web fonts, no images, no icons. Light and dark follow the OS through `prefers-color-scheme`, not the host page. The other surfaces have no system at all. The playground is a browser-default page with one `<pre>`, and there is no docs site yet.
keyCharacteristics: One surface, one table, one control per row (a native `<select>`).
Color carries the HTTP method; everything else is gray.
Flat inside, floating outside: two soft shadows lift the launcher and panel off the host page.
No motion. The panel snaps between `display: none` and `flex`.
Every value hard-coded; there are no tokens or variables.

rules.name: The Method-Is-the-Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color appears only on method pills, plus the active dot, the badge and the danger button. Everything structural is gray.

dos: **Do** keep every style self-contained inside the closed shadow root. Host CSS can't reach in and overlay CSS must not leak out. *(Durable.)*
**Do** follow the OS color scheme. The overlay must read in both light and dark regardless of the host page's palette. *(Durable.)*
**Do** keep the overlay above everything (`z-index` at or near `2147483647`), and keep the launcher clickable when the panel is open. *(Durable.)*
**Do** set monospace for API facts (methods, URLs, scenario names). *(Incumbent pattern, worth keeping.)*
**Do** fit the bundle budget: overlay JS plus CSS at or under 15 kB minified. Don't load anything over the network. *(Durable.)*
donts: **Don't** write `font: … inherit` shorthands. They are invalid and silently fall back to UA fonts. *(Known defect.)*
**Don't** load web fonts, images or icon packages into the overlay. They cost bundle budget and network requests inside someone else's dev page. *(Durable; inline SVG is fine.)*
**Don't** treat the incumbent's stock Tailwind palette, generic gray chrome or absence of brand voice as the identity to preserve. A full redesign is planned. *(Baseline note.)*
**Don't** reuse one red for unrelated meanings (DELETE, a neutral count, destructive confirm), as the incumbent does. *(Observed issue.)*
